counting_unit: Distinct assistant-screened physical boundary assembly; multiple boundaries may share a building.
visibility: Same native boundary object, at least 100 first-hit pixels in at least two of frames 1–6; 160×128 render.
navigation: Reciprocal unobstructed native R2R-style graph; not an MST.
overlap: Symmetric occlusion-aware mesh-supported overlap >=0.15 for every adjacent pair; project setting, not asserted to be a published OST-Bench constant.
input: Only the 12 RGB images from each model_inputs.json are model-visible. Manifests, context labels, masks, depth and audit answers are not prompts.
ground_truth_status: Assistant-screened candidates. Material, pane transparency, door state, shelter and directional reachability are not human-annotated here.
